# Structured extraction binary fixtures

`python-calamine-base.xls` is the small `tests/data/base.xls` fixture from
[`dimastbk/python-calamine`](https://github.com/dimastbk/python-calamine),
retrieved from the upstream `master` branch for native XLS coverage. The
upstream project and fixture are distributed under the MIT License. It is test
data only and does not add a runtime dependency.

SHA-256: `74d3c38abb81a4513051bbc3fb95dca08bc42a339fccfb40db60943b777cd89a`.
